title: SENSE-7: Taxonomy and Dataset for Measuring User Perceptions of Empathy in Sustained Human-AI Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a taxonomy and dataset to measure perceived empathy in human-AI interactions. While it includes a 'Prosocial Expression' dimension and a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section, its core objective is benchmarking psychological and interactional empathy rather than evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics as specified in the criteria.
